purpose: Teach: ときには/何一つ/御飯/もうけ/たずね/そうこう/おみやげ/壊れる

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ときには真面目になれよ
lines.en: Riku, you need to get serious sometimes.
lines.style: Exasperated but affectionate. Sharp opening on his name. Quick pace, like she's used to nagging him. Softens slightly at the end—she knows he won't listen but she says it anyway.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、宿題何一つやってないだろ?桜
lines.en: You haven't done a single piece of homework, have you? Sakura.
lines.style: Playful deflection. Light, teasing rhythm. Turns it back on her with a small smile in his voice. Doesn't rush the question—lets it hang just long enough to feel like banter.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、御飯食べてから部活来いよ
lines.en: Riku, eat something before you come to club, okay?
lines.style: Bossy but practical. Direct, no-nonsense delivery. She's not asking permission or debating. Slight softening on the last word—genuine concern underneath the instruction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストで点もうけたんだろ?桜
lines.en: You actually did pretty well on that test, didn't you? Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet observation. Surprised by her but trying not to show it. Thoughtful pace. Not quite a question—more like he's testing if she'll admit it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ぼくの家、たずねて来てくれたな
lines.en: Riku… you actually came to see my place.
lines.style: Soft, vulnerable opening. Slight breathiness on his name. She's registering something that mattered. Tender and a little uncertain, like she's checking if he meant it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、そうこうしてる間に試合始まるぞ、桜
lines.en: You, while you're sitting around like that, the match is about to start. Sakura.
lines.style: Urgent, snapping her back to the moment. Sharp attack on the first word. Quick-paced, almost teasing. The tone of someone who cares but won't say it directly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、修学旅行のおみやげ、買ってきてくれたな
lines.en: Riku, you brought back souvenirs from the school trip.
lines.style: Soft wonder, slightly disbelieving. Slow pace. She's touching on something unexpectedly tender from him. Trailing-off at the end like she's still processing that he thought of her.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のスマホ、画面が壊れるかと思ったぜ、桜
lines.en: I thought your phone screen was going to shatter from that reaction, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware amusement. Slight smirk in the delivery. He's ribbing her for overreacting but affectionately. Relaxed pace, letting the joke land naturally.
